items.text:
I really wanted to like this game, It is horribly over complicated for being such a simple concept of a game.

It being complicated isn't what turned me away from it though, cause I do enjoy a complicated game to keep my mind fresh and challenged.  However once you get your ship and fly out to another and attempt to dock the ship for the first time I became soft locked.  The tips are telling you to close clamps when they light up green but they never do, on top of that the comms are Beeping nonstop saying their is no docking port even after I just recieved docking clearance.

I spent close to an hour attempting to dock to the dang thing.  

I will not be coming back to this game at a later time, this was all in the first 5 minutes of the game.  I don't even want to know what other types of bugs are in the game if I'm already being progress locked in the literal beginning.
items.text_zh:
我真的很想喜欢这款游戏，对于这么一个简单的游戏概念来说，它复杂得可怕。

不过，复杂并不是让我远离它的原因，因为我确实喜欢复杂的游戏来保持头脑清醒和接受挑战。然而，当你拿到自己的飞船，飞到另一艘飞船并第一次尝试对接时，我就被软锁了。提示告诉你在夹钳亮绿灯时关闭它们，但它们从来不变绿，除此之外，通讯还不停地哔哔响，说没有对接端口，即使我刚刚收到了对接许可。

我花了将近一个小时试图对接上那该死的东西。

我不会以后再回来玩这款游戏了，这一切都发生在游戏的头5分钟里。如果我 literally 在一开始就被进度锁住了，我甚至不想知道游戏里还有哪些其他类型的bug。
